neighbours.label: an abstract framing noun (question, challenge, goal, hope, problem, aim) as the subject of 'The X is …', announcing what is at stake
fire: Sales are falling fast. The question is whether the new model can reverse the trend.
We have collected the data, and the challenge now is to make sense of it.
Rents keep climbing, so the hope is that new housing will ease the pressure.
The team has trained all winter. The goal is to reach the final in June.
Everyone agrees on the plan; the problem is that nobody wants to pay for it.
The treaty has been signed, but the question remains whether it will be enforced.
The lab has secured funding, and the aim is to begin trials next year.
The software works well enough. The issue is how slowly it starts.
quiet: A reporter put a difficult question to the minister after the speech.
The climbers accepted the challenge and set off before dawn.
She gave up hope of finding her keys and called a locksmith.
The striker scored a late goal to win the match in June.
He solved the last problem on the exam with a minute to spare.
Nobody could answer the question that the child had asked.
He took careful aim and threw the dart at the board.
The latest issue of the magazine arrived in the post today.

notes: Card: ' question' x12, ' challenge', ' goal', ' hope', ' problem', ' aim' right after 'The' and before 'is'; the pole promotes ' is', ' now', ' then', ' remains'. Probes: The question is 0.85, The challenge now is 0.54, the goal is 0.88; 'asked a question' 0.01, 'winning goal' 0.01, 'problem set' 0.13.
